reason: A DSH configuration plugin that adds reasoning-effort controls for hand-declared models, supports gateway value mappings, and provides conditional subagent defaults through a settings page.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 中手动声明的模型提供可配置的推理强度、网关值映射和子代理默认设置。
summaries.en: Configures reasoning-effort levels, gateway mappings, and conditional subagent defaults for hand-declared models in DSH.

capabilities: Adds configurable reasoning-effort levels to hand-declared llm-pi-ai models
Provides per-model mappings from DSH reasoning levels to gateway values
Sets a default reasoning effort for subagent requests that lack an explicit value
Provides multilingual settings for configuring reasoning behavior
